# public-medium Email Fixtures

Synthetic email fixtures at medium scale for regression testing the email
extraction pipeline.

## Contents

| Directory | Format | Count |
|-----------|--------|-------|
| `medium-eml/` | RFC 5322 `.eml` | 13 samples |
| `medium-mbox/` | Thunderbird-style `.mbox` | 55 messages |
| `medium-pst/` | Synthetic Unicode `.pst` / `.ost` | 10 messages each |

## Visibility

public-medium

## Provenance

All samples are synthetic and distributed under the repository MIT license.
The fixture set was reviewed to contain only reserved example-domain identities;
it contains no personal data, credentials, session tokens, or workstation paths.

- `medium-eml/` and `medium-mbox/` are generated by `scripts/generate_medium_email_fixtures.py`.
- `medium-pst/` is generated by `crates/containers-pst/examples/generate_medium_fixture.rs`.

## Expected JSON

`expected.json` in this directory describes the assertions used by the
`public_medium_email_fixtures_match_expected` regression test in
`crates/app-services/tests/unit/analysis_service/extraction/email/mod.rs`.
